entries.title: Theme editor
entries.text: Edit colour and style themes token by token: a Colour section and a Style section with every token in folding categories. Copy a theme, save it, load any theme.

entries.title: Theme editor settings
entries.text: The Theme editor under Settings → Plugins: the editor itself, its starting view, and install & uninstall.

entries.title: View
entries.text: Switches how the tokens are shown: Tree (folding categories), Grid (one table), Swatches (colours and samples) or Compare (your draft next to another theme).

entries.title: Tree view
entries.text: Sections and categories you fold open, with an editor for every token.

entries.title: Grid view
entries.text: Every token in one table with its category and an editor.

entries.title: Swatches view
entries.text: Colours as swatches and style tokens as samples; tap one to edit it.

entries.title: Compare view
entries.text: Puts your draft next to another theme, marks what differs and lets you take the other value.

entries.title: Find a token
entries.text: Filters every section to tokens whose name, path or category matches what you type.

entries.title: Copy
entries.text: Starts a new theme from the one you're editing: both sections become an unsaved draft, ready for a new name.

entries.title: Copy as JSON
entries.text: Copies the colour and style drafts to the clipboard as standard asset@1 JSON, for pasting into another app or a file.

entries.title: Paste themes
entries.text: Loads colour or style themes from asset@1 JSON on the clipboard into the editor as drafts.

entries.title: Load a theme file
entries.text: Opens an asset@1 theme file (one theme or a list) and loads it into the editor.

entries.title: Back to the active themes
entries.text: Throws away your unsaved edits and shows the themes in force again.

entries.title: Load colour theme
entries.text: Picks any colour theme the app has (built-in, saved in the editor or the Theme manager) to edit. Nothing changes until you save.

entries.title: Load style theme
entries.text: Picks any style theme the app has to edit. Nothing changes until you save.

entries.title: Theme name
entries.text: The name your saved themes get. The colour part is saved as <name>-colors and the style part as <name>-style.

entries.title: Save & apply
entries.text: Saves the edited sections as standard asset@1 themes and applies them. The pick goes to the hub look, so every app follows.

entries.title: Load
entries.text: Loads this saved theme into the editor to change it.

entries.title: Take
entries.text: Copies the other theme's value for this token into your draft.

entries.title: Compare with
entries.text: The theme your draft is compared with.

entries.title: Only differences
entries.text: Lists only the tokens where your draft and the other theme differ.

entries.title: Values other themes use
entries.text: Picks a value another theme of this kind uses for the token, such as a font stack or a shadow.

entries.title: Preview field
entries.text: A sample field drawn with your draft, so you can see it before saving. Typing here does nothing.

entries.title: Preview switch
entries.text: A sample switch drawn with your draft. It does nothing.

entries.title: Starting view
entries.text: The view the Theme editor opens in: Tree, Grid, Swatches or Compare.

entries.title: List tokens the theme doesn't set
entries.text: Shows every token the asset types and other themes know, even when the theme you're editing leaves it out (marked “not set”).

steps.say: Pick a view up here: tree, grid, swatches or compare.
Every colour and style token is listed in folding categories. Change any value; the preview card shows the draft.
Name it and tap Save and apply. Every app follows through the hub look.
